hero.heading: Representing and Supporting General Practice in Manchester
hero.lead: Your statutory representative body — standing up for 400 GPs across 87 practices, providing expert guidance, confidential support, and a strong collective voice for primary care.

serviceCards.title: Guidance Library
serviceCards.text: Access our searchable library of clinical guidance, contractual documents, CQC templates, and policy resources.

serviceCards.title: GP Support
serviceCards.text: Confidential advisory service for GMC concerns, complaints, suspension, partnership disputes, and CQC inspections.

serviceCards.title: Wellbeing Hub
serviceCards.text: Mental health resources, peer support programmes, free apps, and crisis contacts for GPs and practice staff.

serviceCards.title: Vacancies
serviceCards.text: Browse GP and primary care vacancies across Manchester, or post your own practice vacancy to reach local candidates.

serviceCards.title: Events & Meetings
serviceCards.text: LMC committee meetings, educational events, and networking sessions — in-person and online throughout the year.

serviceCards.title: Members Area
serviceCards.text: Subscriber-only resources, meeting agendas, minutes archive, open forum, and the Manchester GP Network.

newsletter.title: Manchester LMC Newsletter — Winter 2025/26
newsletter.description: Our quarterly newsletter covers the latest from general practice in Manchester: contract updates, local policy news, wellbeing resources, and LMC committee actions.
